atoms.text: Im Folgenden lernst du die unregelmäßigen Verben to meet, to read, to speak und to tell kennen.
atoms.sound: Im Folgenden lernst du die unregelmäßigen Verben <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>to meet, to read, to speak</voice> und <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>to tell</voice> kennen.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to meet in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>to meet</voice> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: It is nice to meet you.
I have met my best friends at school.
atoms.b: I have ((met)) my best friends at school.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to read in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>to read</voice> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: I love to read books in the park.
atoms.b: I love to ((read)) books in the park.

atoms.sound: Last week she read a book about dinosaurs.
atoms.b: Last week she ((read)) a book about dinosaurs.

atoms.sound: He has read many books since last year.
atoms.b: He has ((read)) many books since last year.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to speak in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>to speak</voice> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: I want to speak with him at lunch.
atoms.b: I want to ((speak)) with him at lunch.

atoms.sound: I haven't spoken with her in years.
atoms.b: I haven't ((spoken)) with her in years.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to tell in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>to tell</voice> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: I have to tell you a secret.
atoms.b: I have to ((tell)) you a secret.

atoms.sound: She told me to be there at 7 o'clock.
atoms.b: She ((told)) me to be there at 7 o'clock.

atoms.sound: My teachers have told me to do my homework.
atoms.b: My teachers have ((told)) me to do my homework.
